The grounds are undoubtedly one of Glenavon's most appealing features. Thoughtfully laid out from the outset and developed over successive decades, the mature gardens contain a wonderful variety of features including meandering pathways, a wishing well, ornamental pond, internal and external stone garden walls and colourful established planting. The gardens provide an exceptional degree of privacy, colour and seasonal interest, while the orientation and layout allow the grounds to benefit from excellent sunlight from morning through to evening.
